title: LMDB: test open_test_db() helper has fragile drop order
description: crates/lmdb/src/lib.rs: test helper open_test_db() returns (LmdbBlockDb, TempDir). Rust drops tuple fields in declaration order, so LmdbBlockDb is dropped before TempDir. This is correct but accidental — if the tuple order is reversed in a future refactor, TempDir would be dropped first (deleting the directory) while LmdbBlockDb still holds the env open. Fix: document the drop order requirement in a comment, or use a named struct with explicit Drop impl to make the ordering explicit.
